[[File:Onion patch.gif|left|thumb|Onions growing in the garden.]]
Onions are a form of crop which can be grown from [[onion seed]]s in the garden below the [[workyard]] known as the [[Kitchen Garden|kitchen garden]].  Alternatively they can be purchased from the [[Farmer]]. Onions are an improvable crop, meaning they have a variety of quality levels and can be improved with fertilizer.  See the page on [[farming]] for more information on how crops are grown and improved.

==Alchemy==
Onions can be decomposed to powder or extract at the [[Hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at each workstation.
